title: Detention and Scholarship
author: Orsen Halloran
blurb: Astrid Sandoval, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
